mn54:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅguttarāpesu viharati āpaṇaṃ nāma aṅguttarāpānaṃ nigamo.
mn54:2.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya āpaṇaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn54:2.2: āpaṇe piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena aññataro vanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkami divāvihārāya
mn54:2.3: taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogahetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
mn54:3.1: potaliyopi kho gahapati sampannanivāsanapāpuraṇo chattupāhanāhi jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena so vanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogahetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
mn54:3.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho potaliyaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca
mn54:3.3: saṃvijjanti kho gahapati āsanāni sace ākaṅkhasi nisīdāti.
mn54:3.4: evaṃ vutte potaliyo gahapati gahapativādena maṃ samaṇo gotamo samudācaratīti kupito anattamano tuṇhī ahosi.
mn54:3.5: dutiyampi kho bhagavā potaliyaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca saṃvijjanti kho gahapati āsanāni sace ākaṅkhasi nisīdāti. dutiyampi kho potaliyo gahapati gahapativādena maṃ samaṇo gotamo samudācaratīti kupito anattamano tuṇhī ahosi.
mn54:3.6: tatiyampi kho bhagavā potaliyaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca
mn54:3.7: saṃvijjanti kho gahapati āsanāni sace ākaṅkhasi nisīdāti.
mn54:3.8: evaṃ vutte potaliyo gahapati gahapativādena maṃ samaṇo gotamo samudācaratīti kupito anattamano bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn54:3.9: tayidaṃ bho gotama nacchannaṃ tayidaṃ nappaṭirūpaṃ yaṃ maṃ tvaṃ gahapativādena samudācarasīti.
mn54:3.10: te hi te gahapati ākārā te liṅgā te nimittā yathātaṃ gahapatissāti.
mn54:3.11: tathā hi pana me bho gotama sabbe kammantā paṭikkhittā sabbe vohārā samucchinnāti.
mn54:3.12: yathākathaṃ pana te gahapati sabbe kammantā paṭikkhittā sabbe vohārā samucchinnāti.
mn54:3.13: idha me bho gotama yaṃ ahosi dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā sabbantaṃ puttānaṃ dāyajjaṃ niyyātaṃ tatthāhaṃ anovādī anupavādī ghāsacchādanaparamo viharāmi
mn54:3.14: evañca me bho gotama sabbe kammantā paṭikkhittā sabbe vohārā samucchinnāti.
mn54:3.15: aññathā kho tvaṃ gahapati vohārasamucchedaṃ vadesi aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedo hotīti.
mn54:3.16: yathākathaṃ pana bhante ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedo hoti
mn54:3.17: sādhu me bhante bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedo hotīti.
mn54:3.18: tenahi gahapati suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi bhāsissāmīti.
mn54:3.19: evaṃ bhanteti kho potaliyo gahapati bhagavato paccassosi.
mn54:4.2: aṭṭha kho ime gahapati dhammā ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedāya saṃvattanti
mn54:4.7: apisuṇaṃ vācaṃ nissāya pisuṇā vācā pahātabbā
mn54:4.12: ime kho gahapati aṭṭha dhammā saṅkhittena vuttā vitthārena avibhattā ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedāya saṃvattantīti.
mn54:5.1: yeme pana bhante bhagavatā aṭṭha dhammā saṅkhittena vuttā vitthārena avibhattā ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedāya saṃvattanti sādhu me bhante bhagavā ime aṭṭha dhamme vitthārena vibhajatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
mn54:5.2: tenahi gahapati suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi bhāsissāmīti.
mn54:5.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho potaliyo gahapati bhagavato paccassosi.
mn54:6.1: apāṇātipātaṃ nissāya pāṇātipāto pahātabboti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ
mn54:6.3: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saññojanānaṃ hetu pāṇātipātī assaṃ tesāhaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno
mn54:6.4: ahañceva kho pana pāṇātipātī assaṃ attāpi maṃ upavadeyya pāṇātipātapaccayā anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ pāṇātipātapaccayā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā pāṇātipātapaccayā
mn54:6.5: etadeva kho pana saññojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ pāṇātipāto
mn54:6.6: ye ca pāṇātipātapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā pāṇātipātā paṭiviratassa evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti
mn54:6.8: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:7.1: dinnādānaṃ nissāya adinnādānaṃ pahātabbanti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ
mn54:7.3: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saññojanānaṃ hetu adinnādāyī assaṃ tesāhaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno
mn54:7.4: ahañceva kho pana adinnādāyī assaṃ attāpi maṃ upavadeyya adinnādānapaccayā anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ adinnādānapaccayā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā adinnādānapaccayā
mn54:7.5: etadeva kho pana saññojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ adinnādānaṃ
mn54:7.6: ye ca adinnādānapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighāta pariḷāhā adinnādānā paṭiviratassa evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti
mn54:7.8: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:8.1: saccaṃ vācaṃ nissāya musāvādo pahātabboti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ
mn54:8.3: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saññojanānaṃ hetu musāvādī assaṃ tesāhaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno
mn54:8.4: ahañceva kho pana musāvādī assaṃ attāpi maṃ upavadeyya musāvādapaccayā anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ musāvādapaccayā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā musāvādapaccayā
mn54:8.5: etadeva kho pana saññojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ musāvādo
mn54:8.6: ye ca musāvādapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighāta pariḷāhā musāvādā paṭiviratassa evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti
mn54:8.8: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:9.1: apisuṇaṃ vācaṃ nissāya pisuṇā vācā pahātabbāti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ
mn54:9.3: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saññojanānaṃ hetu pisuṇavāco assaṃ tesāhaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno
mn54:9.4: ahañceva kho pana pisuṇavāco assaṃ attāpi maṃ upavadeyya pisuṇavācapaccayā anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ pisuṇavācapaccayā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā pisuṇavācapaccayā
mn54:9.5: etadeva kho pana saññojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ pisuṇavācā
mn54:9.6: ye ca pisuṇavācapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighāta pariḷāhā pisuṇāya vācāya paṭiviratassa evaṃsa te āsavā vighāta pariḷāhā na honti
mn54:9.7: apisuṇaṃ vācaṃ nissāya pisuṇā vācā pahātabbāti
mn54:9.8: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:10.1: agiddhilobhaṃ nissāya giddhilobho pahātabboti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ
mn54:10.3: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saññojanānaṃ hetu giddhilobhītha assaṃ tesāhaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno
mn54:10.4: ahañceva kho pana giddhilobhī assaṃ attāpi maṃ upavadeyya giddhilobhapaccayā anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ giddhilobhapaccayā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā giddhilobhapaccayā
mn54:10.5: etadeva kho pana saññojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ giddhilobho
mn54:10.6: ye ca giddhilobhapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā agiddhilobhissa evaṃsa te āsavā vighāta pariḷāhā na honti
mn54:10.8: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:11.1: anindārosaṃ nissāya nindāroso pahātabboti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ
mn54:11.3: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saññojanānaṃ hetu nindārosī assaṃ tesāhaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno
mn54:11.4: ahañceva kho pana nindārosī assaṃ attāpi maṃ upavadeyya nindārosapaccayā anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ nindārosapaccayā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā nindārosapaccayā
mn54:11.5: etadeva kho pana saññojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ nindāroso
mn54:11.6: ye ca nindārosapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighāta pariḷāhā anindārosissa evaṃsa te āsavā vighāta pariḷāhā na honti
mn54:11.8: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:12.1: akodhupāyāsaṃ nissāya kodhupāyāso pahātabboti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ
mn54:12.3: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saññojanānaṃ hetu kodhupāyāsī assaṃ tesāhaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno
mn54:12.4: ahañceva kho pana kodhupāyāsī assaṃ attāpi maṃ upavadeyya kodhupāyāsapaccayā anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ kodhupāyāsapaccayā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā kodhupāyāsapaccayā
mn54:12.5: etadeva kho pana saññojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ kodhupāyāso
mn54:12.6: ye ca kodhupāyāsapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighāta pariḷāhā akodhupāyāsissa evaṃsa te āsavā vighāta pariḷāhā na honti
mn54:12.8: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:13.1: anatimānaṃ nissāya atimāno pahātabboti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ
mn54:13.3: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saññojanānaṃ hetu atimānī assaṃ tesāhaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno
mn54:13.4: ahañceva kho pana atimānī assaṃ attāpi maṃ upavadeyya atimānapaccayā anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ atimānapaccayā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā atimānapaccayā
mn54:13.5: etadeva kho pana saññojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ atimāno
mn54:13.6: ye ca atimānapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighāta pariḷāhā anatimānissa evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti
mn54:13.8: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:14.1: ime kho gahapati aṭṭha dhammā saṅkhittena vuttā vitthārena avibhattā ye ariyassa vinaye pahānāya vohārasamucchedāya saṃvattanti
mn54:14.2: na tveva tāva gahapati ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārassa samucchedo hotīti.
mn54:14.3: yathākathaṃ pana bhante ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedo hoti
mn54:14.4: sādhu me bhante bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārassa samucchedo hotīti.
mn54:14.5: tenahi gahapati suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi bhāsissāmīti.
mn54:14.6: evaṃ bhanteti kho potaliyo gahapati bhagavato paccassosi.
mn54:15.1: seyyathāpi gahapati kukkuro jighacchādubbalyapareto goghātakasūnaṃ paccupaṭṭhito assa
mn54:15.2: tamenaṃ dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā aṭṭhikaṅkalaṃ sunikantaṃ nikantaṃ nimmaṃsaṃ lohitamakkhitaṃ upacchūbheyya
mn54:15.4: api nu so kukkuro amuṃ aṭṭhikaṅkalaṃ sunikantaṃ nikantaṃ nimmaṃsaṃ lohitamakkhitaṃ palehanto jighacchādubbalyaṃ paṭivineyyāti.
mn54:15.7: aduṃ hi bhante aṭṭhikaṅkalaṃ sunikantaṃ nikantaṃ nimmaṃsaṃ lohitamakkhitaṃ
mn54:15.8: yāvadeva ca pana so kukkuro kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assāti.
mn54:15.9: evameva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
mn54:15.10: aṭṭhikaṅkalūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyoti
mn54:15.11: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā yāyaṃ upekkhā nānattā nānattasitā taṃ abhinivajjetvā yāyaṃ upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā yattha sabbaso lokāmisupādānā aparisesā nirujjhanti tameva upekkhaṃ bhāveti.
mn54:16.1: seyyathāpi gahapati gijjho vā kaṅkho vā kulalo vā maṃsapesimādāya uḍḍayeyya
mn54:16.2: tamenaṃ gijjhāpi kaṅkhāpi kulalāpi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitaccheyyuṃ virājeyyuṃ
mn54:16.4: sace so gijjho vā kaṅkho vā kulalo vā taṃ maṃsapesiṃ na khippameva paṭinissajjeyya so tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā niggaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhanti.
mn54:16.6: evameva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
mn54:16.7: maṃsapesūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyoti
mn54:16.8: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā yāyaṃ upekkhā nānattā nānattasitā taṃ abhinivajjetvā yāyaṃ upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā yattha sabbaso lokāmisupādānā aparisesā nirujjhanti tameva upekkhaṃ bhāveti.
mn54:17.1: seyyathāpi gahapati puriso ādittaṃ tiṇukkaṃ ādāya pativātaṃ gaccheyya
mn54:17.3: sace so puriso taṃ ādittaṃ tiṇukkaṃ na khippameva paṭinissajjeyya tassa sā ādittā tiṇukkā hatthaṃ vā ḍaheyya bāhuṃ vā ḍaheyya aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā aṅgapaccaṅgaṃ vā ḍaheyya so tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhanti.
mn54:17.5: evameva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
mn54:17.6: tiṇukkūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyoti
mn54:17.7: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā …pe… tameva upekkhaṃ bhāveti.
mn54:18.1: seyyathāpi gahapati aṅgārakāsu sādhikaporisā pūrā aṅgārānaṃ vītaccikānaṃ vītadhūmānaṃ
mn54:18.2: atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikkūlo
mn54:18.3: tamenaṃ dve balavanto purisā nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuṃ upakaḍḍheyyuṃ
mn54:18.5: api nu so puriso iti cīti ceva kāyaṃ sannāmeyyāti.
mn54:18.8: viditaṃ hi bhante tassa purisassa imañca ahaṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ papatissāmi tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā niggacchissāmi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhanti.
mn54:18.9: evameva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
mn54:18.10: aṅgārakāsūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyoti
mn54:18.11: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā …pe… tameva upekkhaṃ bhāveti.
mn54:19.1: seyyathāpi gahapati puriso supinakaṃ passeyya ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇirāmaṇeyyakaṃ
mn54:19.3: evameva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
mn54:19.4: supinakūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyoti …pe…
mn54:20.1: seyyathāpi gahapati puriso yācitakaṃ bhogaṃ yācitvā yānaṃ oropeyya pavaramaṇikuṇḍalaṃ
mn54:20.2: so tehi yācitakehi bhogehi purakkhato parivuto antarāpaṇaṃ paṭipajjeyya
mn54:20.4: bhogī vata bho puriso evaṃ kira bhogino bhogāni bhuñjantīti
mn54:20.5: tamenaṃ sāmikā yattha yattheva passeyyuṃ tattha tattheva sāmikā sāni hareyyuṃ
mn54:20.6: taṃ kiṃ maññasi gahapati alaṃ nu kho tassa purisassa aññathattāyāti.
mn54:20.10: evameva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
mn54:20.11: yācitakūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyoti …pe…
mn54:21.1: seyyathāpi gahapati gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre tibbo vanasaṇḍo
mn54:21.2: tatrassa rukkho sampannaphalo ca uppannaphalo ca na cāssu kānici phalāni bhūmiyaṃ patitāni
mn54:21.3: atha puriso āgaccheyya phalatthiko phalagavesī phalapariyesanaṃ caramāno
mn54:21.4: so taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhetvā taṃ rukkhaṃ passeyya sampannaphalañca uppannaphalañca
mn54:21.6: ayaṃ kho rukkho sampannaphalo ca uppannaphalo ca natthi ca kānici phalāni bhūmiyaṃ patitāni
mn54:21.8: yannūnāhaṃ imaṃ rukkhaṃ abhiruyhitvā yāvadatthañca khādeyyaṃ ucchaṅgañca pūreyyanti
mn54:21.9: so taṃ rukkhaṃ abhiruyhitvā yāvadatthañca khādeyya ucchaṅgañca pūreyya
mn54:21.10: atha dutiyo puriso āgaccheyya phalatthiko phalagavesī phalapariyesanaṃ caramāno tiṇhaṃ kudhāriṃ ādāya
mn54:21.11: so taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogahetvā taṃ rukkhaṃ passeyya sampannaphalañca uppannaphalañca
mn54:21.13: ayaṃ rukkho sampannaphalo ca uppannaphalo ca natthi ca kānici phalāni bhūmiyaṃ patitāni
mn54:21.14: na kho panāhaṃ jānāmi rukkhaṃ abhiruyhituṃ
mn54:21.15: yannūnāhaṃ imaṃ rukkhaṃ mūlato chetvā yāvadatthañca khādeyyaṃ ucchaṅgañca pūreyyanti
mn54:21.18: amuko so puriso paṭhamaṃ rukkhaṃ āruḷho sace kho so na khippameva oroheyya tassa so rukkho papatanto hatthaṃ vā bhañjeyya pādaṃ vā bhañjeyya aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā aṅgapaccaṅgaṃ bhañjeyya so tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā niggaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhanti.
mn54:21.20: evameva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
mn54:21.21: rukkhaphalūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyoti
mn54:21.22: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā yāyaṃ upekkhā nānattā nānattasitā taṃ abhinivajjetvā yāyaṃ upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā yattha sabbaso lokāmisupādānā aparisesā nirujjhanti tameva upekkhaṃ bhāveti.
mn54:22.1: sa kho so gahapati ariyasāvako imameva anuttaraṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ āgamma anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati
mn54:22.2: seyyathīdaṃ ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
mn54:23.1: sa kho so gahapati ariyasāvako imameva anuttaraṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ āgamma dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate …pe… yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
mn54:24.1: sa kho so gahapati ariyasāvako imaṃyeva anuttaraṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ āgamma āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
mn54:25.1: ettāvatā kho gahapati ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedo hoti
mn54:25.3: yathā ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedo hoti api nu tvaṃ evarūpaṃ vohārasamucchedaṃ attani samanupassīti.
mn54:25.4: ko cāhaṃ bhante yo ca ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedo
mn54:25.5: ārakāhaṃ bhante ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedā
mn54:25.6: mayaṃ hi bhante pubbe aññatitthiye paribbājake anājānīyeva samāne ājānīyāti amaññimha anājānīyeva samāne ājānīyabhojanaṃ bhojimha anājānānīyeva samāne ājānīyaṭṭhāne ṭhapimha
mn54:25.7: bhikkhū pana mayaṃ bhante ājānīyeva samāne anājānīyāti amaññimha ājānīyeva samāne anājānīyabhojanaṃ bhojimha ājānīyeva samāne anājānīyaṭṭhāne ṭhapimha
mn54:25.8: idāni pana mayaṃ bhante aññatitthiye paribbājake anājānīyeva samāne anājānīyāti jānissāma anājānīyeva samāne anājānīyabhojanaṃ bhojissāma anājānīyeva samāne anājānīyaṭṭhāne ṭhapessāma
mn54:25.9: bhikkhū pana mayaṃ bhante ājānīyeva samāne ājānīyāti jānissāma ājānīyeva samāne ājānīyabhojanaṃ bhojissāma ājānīyeva samāne ājānīyaṭṭhāne ṭhapessāma
mn54:25.10: ajanesi vata me bhante bhagavā samaṇesu samaṇapemaṃ samaṇesu samaṇapasādaṃ samaṇesu samaṇagāravaṃ
mn54:26.2: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evameva bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito
mn54:26.3: esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
mn54:26.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti.
